name: fa_client_portal_desktop
description: ACE Wealth Advisory — desktop wrapper for fa_client_portal. Electron-based, ships the Next.js UI inside a native window so the advisor's book never leaves the device.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron
scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist release web/out e2e-output test-results
